why: Paragraph 184 has Holmes tell Miss Stoner to 'undo the hasp' of her window shutters, so the story itself names this fastening as part of the window.

text: That afternoon: Holmes tells Miss Stoner how she is to keep to her room, signal and withdraw
why: Paragraph 184 has Holmes instruct her to confine herself to her room until her stepfather returns, then signal with the lamp and withdraw. The lawn conversation takes place in the afternoon, when the stepfather is away.

text: To-night, once Dr. Roylott has retired: Miss Stoner is to open the shutters and undo the hasp
why: Paragraph 184 states she should wait until she hears her stepfather retire for the night, then open the shutters, undo the hasp, and put the lamp in the window.
